name: response-pack
title: DRAFT tender response pack
for_each: select id,name from bids order by name

sections.title: Readiness
sections.sql: select name,customer,due,status,decision from bid_readiness where id=$1
sections.note: Human review required. This is not a customer-format submission or evidence that anything was sent.

sections.title: Responses and evidence
sections.sql: select section,question,answer,source,approved_by,state from response_queue where bid_id=$1 order by section,question

name: reviewer-brief
title: DRAFT reviewer brief
for_each: select id,name from bids where status='open' order by name

sections.title: Outstanding responses
sections.sql: select section,question,owner,due,state from response_queue where bid_id=$1 and state<>'approved' order by due

name: privacy-review
title: Contact-data retention review
for_each: select id,name from bids order by name

sections.title: Recorded purpose and next review
sections.note: Check lawful purpose, disclosure permissions and source records. This reminder is not a compliance certificate.
